⚡ About Me
I am an Information Technology student at Hanoi University of Industry transitioning from frontend development into full-stack engineering. My core strength lies in building responsive, type-safe user interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, alongside developing backend services and databases using Node.js, Java, and MongoDB. I prioritize maintainable code, predictable state management, and fast load times over unnecessary complexity. Currently open to Frontend and Full-Stack Developer internships or junior roles.
